pages.title: Fan Catalyst
pages.text:
A **fan catalyst** is what an Encased Fan blows through. Water washes, fire or a campfire smokes, lava blasts, soul fire haunts.\
\
A Blaze Burner works for blasting and smoking. Add-ons add more: powder snow, Liquid Dye, Enriching Fire, Conduit Cages.
